items.title: 22.6 Reactions of Phenol (phenol ke reactions) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 22.6, printed page 92 (PDF 95).

blocks.text: Phenols bohat types ke reactions karte hain, kyun ke in ki electron-rich (electrons se bhari) benzene ring aur polar OH group dono chemical reactions mein hissa le sakte hain. Phenols ke kuch reactions neeche diye gaye hain: -OH group ke reactions 22.6.1 mein aur ring ke reactions 22.6.2 mein.

blocks.prompt: Phenol molecule ke kaun se do hisse reactions mein hissa lete hain?
blocks.explanation: Polar -OH group aur electron-rich aromatic (benzene) ring.

items: Phenol apne -OH group aur apne benzene ring, dono par react karta hai.
